name: from_collapse_limit
description: Controls whether the planner merges subqueries into upper queries based on the maximum allowed number of items in the resulting FROM list.
symptoms: Poor performance on complex multi-subquery queries
tuning_tips: Increase cautiously for complex queries with many correlated subqueries to improve plan quality; avoid setting it >= geqo_threshold unless intentional, as it may trigger GEQO and degrade plan quality. Monitor planning time and plan stability after changes.
